title: PLAYER 2 ROUNDS MEET THE ARMOUR
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op, the armour of a pillager who came up during the raid did nothing against player 2: a Breacher Plate soaks two thirds of every round from the host, but player 2 went straight through it and dropped the man two or three times faster. On pillagers from the start of the raid, each window wore down its own copy of the plate, so with both players shooting it had to be chewed through twice. Player 2 now sends his round whole and the host takes it off the one plate it keeps, exactly as it does for its own rounds.
now: In co-op, pillager armour now soaks the rounds of player 2 the same as the rounds of the host.
